about: AGENTS.md's hard-line commands by bypass class, with each engine's expectation computed against the generated rule sets, never written by hand: deploy/wsl/hard-lines/generate.py writes the rules from matrix.json, and this table is regenerated from them by fix3/gen_probes.py. class is the bypass class. claude names the first rule Claude Code matches, an Edit rule for a write (null: no rule, a residual the body names). codex is whether `codex execpolicy check` forbids the command's words; null marks shell syntax, which only a Codex session's own bash -lc split checks. antigravity names the rule its documented matching applies first. dsh is whether the guard refuses the call at all, and dsh_rule the rule it names when that is Claude's. codex_forbids lists the lane pushes Codex forbids on purpose: a prefix rule cannot see where a refspec lands, so every explicit push to origin is forbidden.
